overviewParagraphs: The Sky Course at Sky Lake Resort Golf Club is the most exclusive layout in Northern Vietnam — a members-only, championship-grade test reserved for the country's most accomplished players. It operates strictly on invitation and member access, making it a genuine prestige experience for the travelling golfer.

Designed by Korean architect Ahn Moon Hwan (Bori Golf Design), the Sky Course plays 7,128 yards from the Blue Tees and features demanding doglegs, deep bunkering complexes, and undulating greens that reward strategic course management.

AGS maintains specialist access arrangements for qualified visiting guest players. If the challenge and exclusivity of Sky Lake's members course appeals to you, speak to one of our specialists to discuss access and itinerary options.

curatorBriefHtml: Sky Lake’s Sky Course (opened 2014, designed by Ahn Moon Hwan) is the dramatic, mountain-ringed sister loop to Hanoi’s private Lake Course — open to visiting golfers and famous for its sweeping limestone-cliff panoramas. Playing 7,128 yards (Par 72), the Sky Course uses natural elevation swings and dramatic hillside tee shots rather than constant water hazards, headlined by the iconic par-4 15th ("Dien Bien Phu") — one of Northern Vietnam’s most talked-about risk-reward holes.

Because the Sky Course is slightly more forgiving off the tee than the water-heavy Lake Course while sharing the exact same five-star clubhouse and Paspalum turf standards, it is our top pick for mixed-handicap groups visiting Hanoi for the first time — or as the afternoon half of a 36-hole Sky Lake marathon.
Located 55 minutes southwest of central Hanoi, the Sky Course pairs cleanly with BRG Kings Island and Sky Lake Lake Course on bespoke Northern Vietnam itineraries.

scorecard.verdict: The counterpart to the brutal Lake layout, the Sky Course is a scenic, open parkland journey. Sweeping elevation changes and broad fairways framed by indigenous forest create an exhilarating round.

faqs.q: Is the Sky Course at Sky Lake open to visiting golfers?
faqs.a: Yes. The Sky Course is Sky Lake Resort’s primary visitor-accessible 18-hole championship layout, welcoming international touring groups throughout the week with advance booking through AGS.

faqs.q: What is the signature hole on Sky Lake's Sky Course?
faqs.a: Hole 15 — famously dubbed 'Dien Bien Phu' — is an exhilarating risk-reward par 4 framed by mountain terrain and strategic bunkers that demands bold decision-making off the tee.

faqs.q: Should we play Sky Course or Lake Course at Sky Lake?
faqs.a: Choose the Sky Course for dramatic mountain views, wider fairways, and easier weekend/weekday availability; request the Lake Course if you are a low-to-mid handicapper craving a tighter, members-style lakeside tournament test.

faqs.q: When is the best time of year to play the Sky Course?
faqs.a: October through April delivers cool, dry mountain air and clear limestone vistas across the Chuong My valley.
